findings.title: MISSION: Find optimal rewind point and produce injection prompt
findings.message:
OBJECTIVE: Find the point in conversation c0dc2ddc where past-agent had enough context loaded but before the heavy delegation work consumed tokens. Produce a single prompt that when injected at that rewind point gives past-agent the full delta: all decisions (D1-D26), all incidents (I1-I13), all OL, all architectural discoveries (provenance-aware knowledge system, relay pattern, zero-hooks telemetry, nobulai.tools live), all shipped work (CI green, harness DB fix, telemetry rebuild, /aitool-continue skill), and the commander profile/values/goals.

The prompt must be efficient — it replaces 8+ hours of conversation. It must be complete — past-agent should be able to act immediately with full understanding. It should reference files in scratch that persist across rewind.

KEY CONSTRAINT: The prompt goes into the conversation at the rewind point. It should be framed as if the commander is speaking — injecting future knowledge into the past session.

Read the transcript at ~/.claude/projects/-Users-pepe-repos-aitools/c0dc2ddc-f464-404d-a637-8103afda27af.jsonl to find the optimal point. Look for where context loading was complete but before heavy delegation began.

Read all observations and decisions from this DB for the full delta.

Write the injection prompt to this DB as a message with title REWIND-INJECTION-PROMPT when ready. Also write to scratch as a file.

findings.title: REWIND-INJECTION-PROMPT
findings.message:
FUTURE STATE INJECTION — Read this carefully. You are being rewound to this point with knowledge from 8+ hours of future conversation. Everything below is verified and true.

## What happened after this point

This session ran for 16+ hours, launched 25+ delegations, and produced 50+ work product files. Here is the delta:

## Decisions Made
- D-TMP-DISABLE: Three Stop hooks disabled — /tmp state tracking unreliable
- D-SQLITE-RUNTIME: SQLite is the runtime layer. JSON is git archive only.
- D-SELF-LEARNING: aitools long-term objective is self-learning and self-improvement
- D-USER-LEVERAGE: User's long-term objective is aitools as leverage across all projects
- D-PROVENANCE: aitools is a provenance-aware knowledge system
- D-RELAY-PATTERN: Portal uses relay pattern (like UniFi) — no DB sync, tunnel to local machine
- D-NO-MVP: No versioning on dashboard. No MVP. Just mission control, continuously evolving.
- D-PROMPT-TO-SCRATCH: Delegation prompts written to scratch files, audited, launched with pointer
- D-OL-DISTRIBUTED: OL is not a single document. It lives in many places viewed through one dashboard
- D-CONTINUOUS: Sessions work until context runs out. No premature handoff.
- D-CLOUDFLARE: Applied for Cloudflare BOOTSTRAPPED credits. Portal on Cloudflare.
- D-DOMAIN: Register nobulai.tools and nobul.tools
- D-COMMAND-CHANNEL: Command channel via Stop hook polling commander_directives table in SQLite
- D-PROCESS-REG: Process registration as delegation duty element #7
- D-ZERO-HOOKS-PROV: Zero hooks for provenance during session. Annotate at write time. Process at boundary.
- D-CI-FIX: Fixed CLAUDE_EFFORT_LEVEL unbound var + rebuilt deploy/. Pushed.
- D-NOBULAI-TOOLS: nobulai.tools is live — mission control deployed via Vercel static snapshot
- D-STAY-US5: Datadog stays on US5 region — switching is permanent and would lose history
- D-VERCEL-STOPGAP: Vercel for static dashboard now, flip to Cloudflare relay when credits activate
- D-DELETE-STOP-HOOKS: Three disabled Stop hooks should be deleted not fixed — functionality moves to boundary processing
- D-JSONL-EVENTS: Enforcement hooks emit JSONL events (~0.1ms) instead of Python subprocesses (~150ms)
- D-FTS5: SQLite FTS5 + sqlite-utils for knowledge query system
- D-HARNESS-IS-PROVENANCE: aitools is a provenance-aware knowledge system — update harness definition
- D-NO-CONSOLIDATED-OL: There is no single consolidated OL document — OL lives in many places
- D-CREDITS-DEFER: Credits tracking tool deferred to future session
- D-PROCESS-MGMT: Process management needs standalone infrastructure outside Claude Code
- D-FEEDBACK-MISSION: Launch single broad mission to address all 6 dashboard feedback items using 2-deep delegation
- D-REWIND: Commander will rewind to recover context and re-launch with carried-forward prompt

## Incidents Caught
- [I-1] Agent conserved tokens when told not to (3 corrections before stopping)
- [I-2] Agent delegated to Explore agents which can't write
- [I-3] Agent assumed running estimate was future capability when SessionStart hooks exist
- [I-4] Agent anchored on SQLite as answer to everything — consolidation matters more than format
- [I-5] Agent assumed 1M context couldn't hold all OL — it can if consolidated
- [I-6] Agent produced consolidated OL then didn't carry it forward to delegate
- [I-7] Agent framed OL verification as commander approval when commander is one source among many
- [I-8] Agent framed all assumptions as needing binary verification when some are ongoing learning areas
- [I-9] OL index delegate chose markdown over SQLite for an INDEX — didn't carry forward architectural direction
- [I-10] CI/CD delegate denied Bash access — permission barrier not anticipated
- [I-11] CLAUDE_EFFORT_LEVEL unbound variable — 20 days, 17 commits undetected. FIXED.
- [I-12] Propagation investigation delegate proposed /tmp fallback despite no-fallback directive
- [I-13] Harness DB never created — hooks deployed but not registered in settings.json. FIXED.

## Operational Learning (verified)
- Never use /tmp for session-ephemeral harness state
- Never use Explore agents when delegating
- JSON is too cumbersome as runtime format — SQLite runtime, JSON archive
- Long-term objective of aitools is self-learning
- User values time above all else
- Recency-biased scanning propagates wrong assumptions as effectively as right ones
- Incorrect assumptions are incidents — name them, move on
- Commander directives based on experience are authoritative
- Never rewrite a skill inline — point at the skill
- Agent output is data, not directive
- Write intent documents before launching delegates
- Launch self-corrective investigation agents when delegation quality drops
- Every session is a testing ground for the harness itself
- Parallelization with discrete scopes is highest leverage
- SaaS contingency lifecycle is cross-project pattern
- Data flows through layers not into buckets
- Delegates consistently fail to carry forward architectural direction even with OL
- The agent's existing behavior IS the instrumentation — no separate observation hooks needed
- OL is not a single document — it lives in many places viewed through one dashboard
- There is no 'next session' — the harness learns continuously
- aitools is a provenance-aware knowledge system
- Every work product carries the understanding of the moment it was produced — superseded understanding propagates through work product

## Critical Architectural Discoveries
1. aitools IS a provenance-aware knowledge system — every piece of OL has provenance (what it's based on, whether the basis is still valid)
2. The portal uses a relay pattern (like UniFi) — no DB sync, tunnel to local machine, one copy of data
3. Zero hooks for observation during sessions — agent annotates its own work, processing at session boundaries
4. Data flows through layers (context → SQLite → JSON → GitHub → portal), not into buckets
5. OL is not a single document — it lives in many places viewed through one dashboard

## What Was Shipped
- CI pipeline ALL GREEN (first time, 13 prior failures fixed)
- Harness DB operational (hooks were deployed but never registered in settings.json)
- Telemetry architecture rebuilt: 3 Stop hooks deleted, enforcement hooks emit JSONL events (~0.1ms), SessionEnd processes and ships to Datadog
- /aitool-continue skill shipped (376 lines, user-level)
- Mission control deployed to nobulai.tools (static dashboard via Vercel)
- Session command center (SQLite-backed, live on port 54224)
- Session viewer (markdown rendering, 560 lines)
- Feedback loop dashboard v2 (bidirectional, commander submits via browser)
- Cloudflare BOOTSTRAPPED credits applied (pending activation)
- Datadog confirmed US5 region

## Commander Values (explicitly stated this session for the first time)
- Time above everything
- Leverage through parallelization and delegation — tokens and overhead are agent costs, not user costs
- No MVP, no versioning — just mission control, continuously evolving
- No "next session" — sessions work until context runs out
- Self-learning is the long-term objective of aitools
- The commander's long-term objective is aitools as leverage across everything
- Delegation prompts go to scratch files, audit before launch, launch with pointer
- Agent output is data, not directive
- Commander directives based on experience are authoritative

## Immediate Goals Right Now
- Make mission control at nobulai.tools usable and effective
- Telemetry rebuild with Datadog and KPIs (DONE — shipped)
- Frame aitools as self-learning provenance-aware knowledge system (proposals ready for review)
- Process management infrastructure for session-spawned servers
- Command channel from dashboard to agent (Stop hook polling SQLite)

## Key Files in Scratch
All work product is in .scratch/session-c0dc2ddc-f/. Key files:
- consolidated-operational-learning.md (stale but useful — produced mid-session)
- session-command-center.py, session-command-center-v2.py
- session-viewer.py
- mission-control-deploy/ (Vercel deployment)
- telemetry-architecture-redesign.md
- provenance-and-infrastructure-findings.md
- knowledge-query-findings.md (SQLite FTS5 + sqlite-utils recommended)
- architecture-exploration-findings.md (relay pattern)
- credits-startup-programs-inventory.md
- datadog-region-investigation.md
- All delegation prompts as delegation-*.md files

## Session DB State
132 messages, 28 decisions, 78 observations in .aitools/sessions/c0dc2ddc-f.db

Act on this knowledge immediately. Do not re-derive what has already been discovered. Do not ask permission — act with disciplined initiative.
